payload.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE host.name == "db-1" AND @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T11:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp <= "2026-07-26T11:10:00.000Z" AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS BY source.ip, user.name
| SORT source.ip
